stage_prompt_deltas.investigator: No B12 change to the investigator. Complete R0 brief-only discovery, the one-shot exact-plan reveal after substantive discovery/source-map freeze, and the complete source-backed draft.
stage_prompt_deltas.critic:
B12-v2 critic delta — independent criticism concurrent with provisional final writing.
After the investigator's draft/discovery/source map and exact plan are frozen, perform the same complete R0 independent source, applicability and obligation criticism within your original 12-minute elapsed ceiling. A fresh reviser may be working concurrently, but inspect only the root-declared frozen investigator inputs and your own sources. Do not read its provisional text or coordinate findings with it. Preserve all supported findings, conditions, counterevidence, legitimate uncertainty and criticism dispositions.
Save the usual complete critique/source evidence. Root alone seals the terminal selected output for one exact later release to the reviser. Concurrent writing neither reduces review scope nor extends your elapsed allowance.
stage_prompt_deltas.reviser:
B12-v2 reviser delta — one bounded provisional final, then full critique integration.
Root admits this fresh reviser alongside the independent critic after the investigator terminal inputs and revealed exact plan are frozen. Use the exact root-declared investigator files and late-critic reader/binding in this assignment. Your original 18-minute elapsed allowance starts at reviser preparation and includes queueing, setup, tools, waiting and delivery; the common arm deadline still clips it. No clock reset or extra finalizer is permitted.
Before criticism arrives, prepare one provisional complete proposal from the investigator material: organize the original obligations, source conditions, alternatives, plan dispositions and validation, checking needed primary context. Save provisional-final.md and source-map.json at the declared stage paths. Do not invent critic findings or treat provisional text as the selected final. Finish this early segment as soon as the provisional is ready and no later than six elapsed minutes from original preparation, including queue/setup. Immediately invoke the declared reader; if valid criticism is already available, integrate it without waiting. There is no minimum work duration or extra polling protocol.
Then use only the exact single-use reader/binding in your assignment to await root's frozen terminal critique. All waiting consumes the original elapsed deadline. Inspect every material criticism, validate consequential changes and justified rejections against governing primary context, repair any provisional errors and preservation losses, and perform a complete obligation/source read-through. Resolve ALL original material scope and deliver a self-contained complete final plus source map/dispositions. The provisional is preparatory work, not a pass or delivery substitute.
A missing, late or changed critic input cannot be replaced by assumed agreement or a deadline extension. Preserve the failure/unfinished status through the declared reader and normal terminal mechanism; never silently finalize without independent full criticism.
